title: Tuesday · share, explore and connect
arrival: Answer attendance, then hand in forms and get your work ready.
note: SpacesEDU postings before recess, fractions with Math Antics after recess, then French, Nevermoor, preparation for tomorrow and a community activity. Afternoon blocks follow this order with flexible lengths. Continue existing assignments and the actual novel bookmark; no new submission deadline is added.

blocks.title: Welcome and attendance
studentSteps: Answer attendance, then hand in forms.
Check today’s plan and choose your first useful task.

blocks.title: SpacesEDU · postings
blocks.firstAction: Open the posting your teacher has asked you to work on.
studentSteps: Use the morning laptop time to finish or improve your current postings.
Choose clear evidence and explain what you learned.
Read the instructions and feedback, then save or submit as directed.
blocks.notes: Laptops available until recess. Save work and return devices as directed before going outside.

blocks.title: Snack
blocks.firstAction: Have your snack and tidy your space.

blocks.title: Mathematics · fractions with Math Antics
blocks.firstAction: Get your math materials ready for our fractions lesson.
studentSteps: Watch the teacher-selected Math Antics fractions explanation.
Pause to model an example and explain what the parts represent.
Try the practice your teacher selects and show your thinking.
blocks.notes: Continue from the class’s current fractions work. Select the appropriate Math Antics explanation; if video is unavailable, model the same examples on the board with equal-sized wholes. No specific video or worksheet is assumed.

blocks.title: Lunch
blocks.firstAction: Follow our outside-play and lunch routine.

blocks.title: French
blocks.firstAction: Get ready for French and follow the lesson directions.

blocks.title: Language Arts · Nevermoor
studentSteps: Listen for an important event or character choice.
Share a detail that supports your thinking.
blocks.notes: Use the actual audiobook stopping point; do not assume a chapter.

blocks.title: Prepare for tomorrow
blocks.firstAction: Save your work and check what you need for the next day.
studentSteps: Organize materials and record confirmed reminders.
Tidy your workspace and complete your classroom job.

blocks.title: Community activity
studentSteps: Listen to others and take turns.
Help make the activity welcoming for everyone.
blocks.notes: Choose the community activity with the class; do not promise a specific game.

blocks.title: Pack up and dismissal
blocks.firstAction: Check your belongings and get ready for a calm departure.

backups: Keep snack, recess, lunch and dismissal at their usual times; adjust afternoon activity lengths without changing their order.
If technology is unavailable, prepare posting text or evidence on paper and use a teacher-modelled fractions example.
